contributions.slice: MODE prescribe: Tergrid's cut, and what in the 99 makes opponents sacrifice or discard; the doctor's write-up as saved
contributions.text:
{
  "reading": "Asked: the cut for Tergrid, God of Fright, which is decided. In the 99, Tergrid is fed by exactly two cards. Grave Pact makes opponents sacrifice a creature on every death of ours, and Archon of Cruelty makes one target opponent sacrifice a creature or planeswalker and discard. Tergrid's own Lantern adds a third route, and opponents' own fetchland and sacrifice outlets are a fourth. Noxious Gearhulk, Cavalier, Assassin's Trophy, Massacre Wurm, Meathook, Hapatra and Yawgmoth destroy or shrink, so they never trigger her. Gisa and Cavalier sacrifice our own creatures. No 5-6 drop outside the keep list exists: Hapatra, Gisa, Cavalier, Gearhulk, Wurm and Grave Titan are keeps and Kokusho is off the table. So the curve cannot stay level without bending a keep.",
  "log_entries_read": [],
  "axes_engaged": [
    {"axis": "interaction", "verdict": "adequate", "measured": {"value": 16},
     "reading": "Tergrid carries removal:edict, so cutting a removal spell leaves the count where it is. The removal component has 10 cards at 93.1%, the deck's most redundant."},
    {"axis": "protection", "verdict": "weakness", "measured": {"value": 2},
     "reading": "Heroic Intervention and Tamiyo's Safekeeping are not candidates."}
  ],
  "cut_candidates": [
    {"card": "Deadly Rollick",
     "why": "Removal is the most redundant component (10 cards, 93.1% in the audit). Tergrid swaps one removal card for another (removal:edict), and her steals come off Grave Pact edicts. The goldfish cannot read Rollick, so this pick is argued from the cards alone.",
     "cost_of_cutting": "The deck's only creature exile, and its only free instant-speed creature kill while Meren is out. Indestructible or recursive threats then fall to edicts (Grave Pact, Archon, the Lantern) and -X effects. Assassin's Trophy, Yawgmoth and Blasting Station remain at instant speed.",
     "orphans_stack": [], "difficulty": "contested"},
    {"card": "Noxious Gearhulk",
     "why": "The only cut that keeps the 5-6 band level (6 out, 5 in). It is the closest overlap: a menace body plus creature removal. Tergrid is a 4/5 menace that also steals.",
     "cost_of_cutting": "It breaks a keep. Each Meren return or reanimation is a destroy plus life. It answers without Grave Pact. Tergrid's removal needs an edict to fire.",
     "orphans_stack": [], "difficulty": "painful"},
    {"card": "Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm",
     "why": "The goldfish row is near-neutral: experience @T7 +0.01 [-0.01, +0.02], no call. The other cheap free outlets cost about 0.45 there (Woe Strider -0.43, Altar of Dementia -0.45).",
     "cost_of_cutting": "Its -2 destroys an artifact or enchantment, a fifth answer to Rest in Peace or Leyline that CONTEXT does not list. It is also fodder and a mill-two. The goldfish probably does not read the flip, so its null is weak. The curve gets heavier by four.",
